Shares are this community’s count divided by the North Delta total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

16 townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods with a median price of $743,500 (the middle half sold between $636,750 and $930,000), taking a median of 32 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $478 per square foot, a median year built of 1988 and a median strata fee of $476 a month. 6 condos sold in Sunshine Hills Woods with a median price of $582,500, taking a median of 46 days to sell at 95.4% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $635 per square foot, a median year built of 2021 and a median strata fee of $406 a month.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Sunshine Hills Woods
Chelsea Gate — 11188 72 Avenue. STRATA (freehold strata)

A townhouse complex on the 72 Avenue corridor: a presale directory (secondary source) describes 60 woodframe townhomes by Westcorp Developments, 3- and 4-bedroom Tudor-style homes beside Cougar Creek, and a current listing records Title to Land: Freehold Strata for its units, classified Townhouse in Sunshine Hills Woods, with a clubhouse, gym/exercise centre and playground in complex amenity records. Year built: listings record 2018 and 2019 for different units — carried as 2018–2019, phased in listing terms; confirm the unit's year on the strata plan. Published rental/pet/age restrictions: UNCONFIRMED from the sources checked.
Cyrus Hill — 7167 116 Street. STRATA

A townhouse complex just south of 72 Avenue: a presale directory (secondary source) describes 40 woodframe townhomes by Bassi Properties, 3- and 4-bedroom homes, with maintenance fees carried in the project record (fees TBA at presale) — a strata project record; current listings classify its units as Townhouse in Sunshine Hills Woods with strata-style management/maintenance amenity records. Year built — CONFLICT in secondary sources: MLS listings consistently record 2021, while the presale record gave an expected completion of Fall/Winter 2019 and one secondary project page states completion in 2019 — carried as completed stock trading as resales, year 2021 per MLS listings, with the 2019 completion claim flagged UNCONFIRMED. Published rental/pet/age restrictions: UNCONFIRMED from the sources checked; confirm title and bylaws on the Form B.
Sunshine Woods — 6300 Cottonwood Street. STRATA

The sub-area's oldest verified townhouse complex: a building directory (secondary source) records it built 1989 with 12 units. The same directory records its restriction as "rentals not allowed" — that rental line is VOID for long-term rentals since November 24, 2022, flagged here in-entry. Published pet/age restrictions beyond that directory line: UNCONFIRMED.
Nicholson Green — 6866 Nicholson Road. STRATA — mixed-form complex, townhouse units counted with the caveat stated

A gated complex built 1991 (listings) in the Nicholson Road pocket, with a clubhouse in listing amenity records. Form conflict stated plainly, both sides carried: one current listing classifies a unit as Row / Townhouse ("end-unit townhome in the heart of Sunshine Hills," 2-storey), while another classifies a ground-floor unit as Apartment/Condo. Unit count and published rental/pet/age restrictions: UNCONFIRMED.
Streets, schools and getting around Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: 3950) — Sunshine Hills, neighbourhood 12 of 14, and Sunshine Woods, neighbourhood 13 of 14. The City publishes no street-by-street written boundary for either neighbourhood; the working grid used in research is 72 Avenue north, 64 Avenue south, Watershed Park and Lyon Road west, Scott Road (120 Street) east — a working grid, not an official boundary.
Nearby areas: Scottsdale to the north-east across Scott Road, Nordel to the north, Panorama Ridge (Surrey) to the south across 64 Avenue, Burns Bog to the west beyond Watershed Park.

Where the townhouse stock concentrates: the edges, not the park interior — the 72 Avenue corridor at the north edge (Chelsea Gate, 11188 72 Avenue; Cyrus Hill, 7167 116 Street just south of 72nd) and the Nicholson Road pocket at the south-east against Scott Road (Sunshine Woods, 6300 Cottonwood Street; Nicholson Green, 6866 Nicholson Road). The detached interior around Watershed Park and Cougar Canyon has no townhouse complex confirmed.

Green anchors: Watershed Park, 11600 Kittson Pkwy, is described by the City as Delta's largest park, with eleven kilometres of gravel trails; Cougar Canyon Environmental Reserve is at 11300 72 Ave and Westview Park at 6500 Westview Dr. Cougar Creek is a salmon-bearing watercourse running through Surrey and Delta, with City bank-stabilization work in Cougar Canyon; streamside setback detail is lot-specific.

Transit runs on the edges: route 340 runs Scottsdale Exchange to 22nd Street Station via Scott Road, 64 Avenue, Kittson Parkway, Highway 91 and the Alex Fraser Bridge, through the Watershed Park edge; route 364 runs Langley Centre to Scottsdale Exchange via 64 Avenue and Scott Road along the south edge; route 319 runs Scott Road Station to Newton Exchange via 72 Avenue along the north edge; the R6 RapidBus runs on Scott Road at the east side. Highway 91 access is via 64 Avenue.

Schools (SD37; address-based): for the sample address 11285 Bond Blvd, the SD37 School Locator result is Sunshine Hills Elementary (K–7), 11285 Bond Blvd., and Seaquam Secondary (8–12), 11584 Lyon Rd.; the locator shows no middle-school category. Listings for the Nicholson Road pocket name Cougar Canyon Elementary and Seaquam Secondary — the elementary result differs by address, so every address must be run in the locator.

Library and recreation: George Mackie Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 8440 112th Street, is north of the area in Nordel; no recreation centre inside the working grid was confirmed — the North Delta Recreation Centre at 11415 84 Avenue serves North Delta. The nearest hospital is Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, in Ladner; the North Delta Public Health Unit is at 11245 84 Avenue.

Market context (SnapStats, combined segment only — never a townhome-only figure): the sub-area recorded Detached inventory 50 / solds 3 / sales ratio 6% (the softest detached ratio of North Delta's four sub-areas that month) and Condos & Townhomes inventory 22 / solds 2 / sales ratio 9% in September 2026.

Property tax and utilities: City of Delta 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on balances outstanding after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 2, 2026; Delta's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: Strata diligence — the Form B regime (all 4 counted complexes are strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. BCREA advises reviewing the Form B for the depreciation report, financial statements, CRF balance and planned work to identify future special levies — for Nicholson Green the Form B is also the document that settles the specific unit's form.

Streamside rules: Cougar Creek is a salmon-bearing watercourse, and any property within 30 m of a stream falls in Delta's Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area, which can limit additions and rebuilds — directly relevant to Chelsea Gate, whose presale record places it alongside Cougar Creek, and to canyon-side lots generally.
EMAIL + CLAIMS CHECK: The correct contact email program-wide is jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: Two of this sub-area's seven candidate townhouse names cannot be verified on any citable source.

A City corridor report (LU009876) covers proposed 72 Avenue corridor pre-zoning and confirms townhouse projects have been built along the corridor under the Mixed Residential designation — Chelsea Gate and Cyrus Hill sit in exactly that corridor, while the Watershed Park interior stays detached.

The Nicholson Road pocket is a different daily life from the park interior. The townhouse and condo pocket at Nicholson Road markets walk-to access to the Scott Road shopping node (Scottsdale Centre across 70 Avenue in the Village at Sunshine Hills directory: Save-On-Foods, Walmart Supercentre, Dollarama, BC Liquor) and Scott Road transit, while the interior's amenity is Watershed Park's eleven kilometres of gravel trails. Same sub-area label, two different products.

A co-op hides in the townhouse pocket. Cougar Canyon Housing Co-operative (6800–6846 Nicholson Road, 18 units) sits in the same Nicholson corridor as the strata complexes, states "No age requirement" in the City guide, and is family co-op housing — a search that treats every attached complex on Nicholson Road as a strata townhouse will mis-describe it.
The sub-area name itself is two neighbourhoods. Verify by address, not by the label.

Delta's flat-rate utility fee is a line item house buyers forget. The City's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home — a fixed annual cost that sits outside both strata fees and property tax for the detached streets around these complexes.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 22 condos and townhomes listed in Sunshine Hills Woods. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sunshine Hills Woods a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Sunshine Hills Woods had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 10 condos and townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods over those 4 months, out of 35 in all of North Delta.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Sunshine Hills Woods sell for?
faq.a: 16 townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $743,500.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: The median was 32 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How many townhouse complexes are in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: Four verified strata complexes — Chelsea Gate (11188 72 Ave, 60 townhomes, 2018–2019), Cyrus Hill (7167 116 St, 40 townhomes, 2021 per MLS listings), Sunshine Woods (6300 Cottonwood St, 12 units, 1989) and Nicholson Green (6866 Nicholson Rd, 1991, mixed-form caveat in). No fee-simple townhouse complex was verified. Canyon Pointe and the Chateau Wynd complexes are UNCONFIRMED and not counted.

faq.q: I read there are six or seven townhouse complexes here. Why does this file say four?
faq.a: Four is the count that survives verification on citable sources — the others are documented as UNCONFIRMED in, not silently dropped. Basis: above.

faq.q: Is Nicholson Green a townhouse complex or a condo building?
faq.a: Both forms appear in its listings: a Row / Townhouse classification for an end-unit townhome and an Apartment/Condo classification for a ground-floor unit, in the same gated 1991 complex.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Sunshine Woods townhouse? The directory says rentals are not allowed.
faq.a: Yes for a long-term tenancy — that directory line is old bylaw text. Rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC; a short-term rental bylaw can still bind you, so read the registered bylaws in the document package.

faq.q: When was Cyrus Hill actually built — 2019 or 2021?
faq.a: The sources conflict: the presale record expected completion in Fall/Winter 2019 and one secondary page states 2019 completion, while MLS listings for its units consistently record 2021.
